source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Tune Up, p.6-11

procedures.title: Fuel pump: additional check
notes: Low pump pressure or volume starves the carburetor and causes a high-speed miss; too much pressure floods the carburetor.

procedures.title: Cooling system: pressure test
steps: Apply test pressure 3 pounds above the cap rating, e.g. 18 pounds for a 15 pound cap (see figure 18 in the manual).
If pressure does not hold, there is an internal or external leak.

procedures.title: Cylinder head torque and valve adjustment: general
steps: Retorque head bolts only if a gasket was replaced or a leak is suspected.
Always adjust valve lash after torquing the heads.
Warm the engine fully before adjusting lash, since clearances change a lot during warm-up.

procedures.title: Valve lash adjustment, hydraulic lifters
steps: With the engine warmed up, take off the rocker covers and gaskets; free a stuck cover by bumping its end rearward with your palm or a rubber mallet, never by prying.
With the engine idling, loosen a rocker arm nut until the rocker starts to clatter.
Tighten the nut slowly until the clatter just stops (zero lash).
Tighten 1/4 turn more and wait 10 seconds for the engine to smooth out; repeat in 1/4 turns with 10 second pauses until the nut is 1 full turn past zero lash.
Do the same for every other valve.
Clean head and cover gasket surfaces with degreaser, fit the covers with new gaskets and torque the bolts to specifications.
notes: Do the 1 turn preload slowly so the lifter can bleed down; going fast can let the intake valve hit the piston, causing internal damage or bent push rods.

procedures.title: Valve lash adjustment, mechanical lifters
steps: Take off the rocker covers and gaskets, bumping the cover end rearward by hand or rubber mallet rather than prying.
Turn the self-locking rocker stud nut with a socket wrench to get the lash in the tune up chart, measured between rocker arm and valve stem with a leaf feeler gauge.
Stop the engine, clean gasket surfaces with degreaser, fit the covers with new gaskets and torque the bolts to specifications.
notes: Figure 19 in the manual shows the oil deflector clips installed on the rocker arms.
